**Avoid rendering historical snapshots during cleanup.** When an affected historical SQL snapshot has no optimized-query cache entry, snapshot loading can render its model and execute its stored Python before `depends_on_past` runs. Catching a render failure does not prevent that execution. An unreadable cache entry can also abort cleanup after the production backfill. Load snapshots for cleanup without optimized-query rendering or dependency preloading. Skipping optimization alone can still render the model through `SnapshotCache.put`.
